dct_description_sm: This tabular dataset contains 159,555 formal legal property descriptions for City of Milwaukee tax keys as of September 18, 2026. RM_TAXKEY corresponds to the parcel tax key and can be used to join the descriptions to the City of Milwaukee Parcel Polygons and Master Property File datasets.
Original source: City of Milwaukee Open Data Portal.
